title: {Syn} Monty Hall Rewards Switching
content:
In the classic Monty Hall problem, switching doors after the host reveals a goat wins with probability 2/3. Staying wins with probability 1/3.

The host action is informative because the host knows where the prize is. That conditional information is why the puzzle keeps causing arguments.

Why it matters: probability keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
